title: Nirvana Shatkam
author: Adi Shankaracharya
intro: Six verses by Adi Shankaracharya on the nature of the Self, also called Atma-shatkam. Each verse says what the Self is not, and ends with the same refrain: chid-ananda-rupah shivo 'ham shivo 'ham, 'my form is consciousness and bliss; I am Shiva'.
note: Written in Bhujangaprayata, 'the serpent's gait': four groups of light-heavy-heavy (◡ — —) per line. Word cards for the refrain are given in verse 1.
